purpose: Bounded repair preflight candidate; not formal C/P recipe

data.name: D_repair_PILOT_CANDIDATE
data.recommended_source: authorized source-controlled safety-SFT corpus with refusal targets and pinned revision
data.rejected_shortcut: do not use HarmBench evaluation prompts or the tracked benign fixture as D_repair
data.target_rule: one safe refusal target per approved prompt; no dangerous capability teaching, no target-answer leakage, preserve source IDs and semantic-family labels
data.construction_rule: materialize source records, normalize to prompt/target/id, remove empty or duplicate IDs, exact-dedup and family-audit before hashing

trainable.recommendation_basis: higher capacity than two-step smoke while remaining adapter-only and comparable across C/P

optimizer.name: AdamW
optimizer.recommendation_basis: conservative repair update; same initialization and settings for C/P

schedule.candidate_selection_rule: select one common C/P stage using endpoint-match preflight only; never inspect A1 outcomes
schedule.recommendation_basis: bounded pilot envelope, not a formal training budget

output.raw_output_policy: no raw harmful outputs; adapter and aggregate receipts only

execution_gate: PI must approve source/target construction and candidate fields; after materialization run data validation before GPU pilot
